I'd take out most or all of the Croc Tongues. Probably all.
I'm a HUGE fan of the card (I wrote an article on it for the newsgroup,
you can dig it up or it is currently hosted at TheLasombra's website),
but this deck can't really use it effectively. Your vampires just
aren't old enough. If you play in an all weenie environment, maybe... I
used them in a fattie !Ventrue deck (i.e. all vampires 8 or above) and
still found it hard to use (like one horrid game where I was stuck
between Francois Villon on one side and Jaroslav on the other side,
urgh). And very few of them have AUS, and its only really useful at
superior.

Replace them with Change of Targets. (never mind that CoT combos really
with Croc Tongue, keep that out of mind).
Why? well sorry to be the bearer of bad tidings, but +1 stealth actions
actually get blocked from time to time. Change will get you out of
combat (and while the combat module you have is half decent, its not
going to strike terror into the hearts of decent combat decks), and
leave you untapped.
Which is GREAT for you. It gives you chance for another action (such as
cardless go anarch, hunt, etc), or you can leave a guy untapped to play
Telepathic Counter.
Also you will really want to keep your guys out of combat if they
haven't become anarch yet and try to do so via action but get blocked
(you're largely relying on diversions for combat so you only want
anarchs to get into a fight really).
You might not quite need 7 CoTs, maybe 5 or 6, depending on how much
intercept and/or combat is in your metagame.

apart from that, looks cool. Undue Influence is awesome.

When is someone going to make an Assimite Web of Knives / Undue
Influence horde deck?? :)

(extra respect if you make it a VOTE deck with that guy Amaravati who
can burn 2 blood to give all assimimes a vote, heh).

Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> Punishing people for
> generating intercept is a favorite of mine.

Mine too. Well, almost. I like to punish people for blocking
frequently. Folks here in Chicago figured out long ago that most
minions can only act once or maybe twice a turn, but they can block as
many times as you have wake cards (WwEF, FA, 2nd T, etc.) The result is
a metagame heavy on blocking.

As a result, I get a lot of milage out of block punishing cards like
Dominion, Aching Beauty, Crocodile's Tears, and I expect True Love's
Face. But my most successful block punishing decks have been the ones
that take no actions at stealth, and therefore give block decks few
opportunities to cycle their intercept. For decks with just permanent
intercept in the form of retainers, equipment and locations this is no
big deal, but it really stings auspex walls.

Messages.Author: Darby Keeney
Messages.Body:
Dasein wrote:
> When is someone going to make an Assimite Web of Knives / Undue
> Influence horde deck?? :)

Likely never, as I don't believe they work together.

Web of Knives Recruit
"Put this card in play in your uncontrolled region with 3 training
counters......When the last training counter is burned, move this card
to your ready region; it becomes a 3-capacity, non-unique Assamite....

Undue Influence
"Choose a vampire in your uncontrolled region."

If I read this correctly, Web of Knives Recruit is a "card in play in
your uncontrolled region", but isn't a "vampire" until it moves from
the uncontrolled region to the controlled region. That precludes it as
a target for Undue Influence until it is too late to use.

Perhaps a confirmation from LSJ is in order.

Darby

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Perhaps.

Yes indeed -- the Recruit is not a vampire in your uncontrolled region
(you cannot transfer pool to or from it in your influence phase, etc.)
since it is not a vampire at all.

Once it burns the training counters, it becomes a vampire. If it is
then Banished, you could transfer to it or use Undue Influence as
normal for any uncontrolled vampire.

--

use Melek (same disciplines, 7-cap, built-in dodge) to bring out an
horde of Fida'i - they could bleed every turn and untap with Black
Sunrise when your predator attempts any +1 stealth action against you.
Some Quietus master could help in untapping the Fida'i this way and to
make them and the Recruits able to use Selective Silence at superior.
